name: probit-p3
description: The user, 11-12 ~11:08: 'we should be trying ply 3 trees against ply 3 flats at ply 3 though no?' Nothing on disk is a ply-3-trained tree (every ply-3/4 model is F-L). Analyst 6.84 design: FROM SCRATCH (a warm start is the rung's question) and MIXED (comparable with the ply-1 r/e/g/h and ply-2 y/v/l families): F-P x2 + T-P-Ne capped (limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03, forget 1) x2, entry_ply 3, seed 61, games_per_cycle 720 (volume ~20 at equal versions, nothing at the plateau; halves the run), self-games, plateau scaled min 300, cap 400, hybrid17 games, hybrid6 training. Read: ply-3 panel of strangers (f3, f3b, w4, x4, x4b, bfp; all flats, so 'against flats'), v150 and the final, plies 2-4; the within-field cell is the matchup. Prediction (6.84): tree minus flat at ply 3 -40..10 (centre -15); the user's odd-ply idea predicts 30-90. Rule: 30+ at the final keeps the odd-ply hypothesis alive (next: a ply-4 mixed field); 0 or less = the tree's advantage is a ply-1 phenomenon, parity unrelated to architecture.
